description: Daily Solana network fees: base fee and priority fee, each in SOL and USD, plus their total. Free tier — covered by Pipeworx's own Solscan key, no caller key needed. Pass range OR from_date+to_date, not both.

from_date.description: Start date, YYYYMMDD. Use together with to_date instead of range.

range.description: Lookback window in days: 30, 90, 180, or 365 (default 30). Ignored if from_date/to_date are given — the vendor rejects any other value with a 400.

to_date.description: End date, YYYYMMDD. Use together with from_date instead of range.

name: get_network_fees
title: Get Network Fees
